gaps.sentence: I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.

gaps.sentence: He spends money ___ it grew on trees.
gaps.explanation: 'As if it grew on trees' — the unreal comparison justifies the criticism.

gaps.sentence: Scarcely had she opened the letter ___ she burst into tears.
gaps.explanation: 'Scarcely... when' marks the immediate consequence of the first event.

gaps.sentence: He works as a waiter ___ studying for his degree.
gaps.explanation: 'While' joins two ongoing actions; 'during' takes a noun.

gaps.sentence: She took notes during the seminar ___ she could write it up that evening.
gaps.explanation: 'So that' introduces the purpose of the action.

gaps.sentence: ___ his salary, he earns royalties from three textbooks.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition to + noun' adds one source of income to another.

gaps.sentence: The results were inconclusive. ___, the team repeated the whole experiment.
gaps.explanation: The inconclusive results caused the repetition: Therefore is the only result linker.

gaps.sentence: Insure the camera ___ it gets damaged in transit.
gaps.explanation: 'In case it gets damaged' = as a precaution against damage.
